Definition: Palti, the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Palti or Phalti = "my deliverance"; 1) son of Raphu, the spy chosen from the tribe of Benjamin; 2) son of Laish, the man to whom king Saul gave his daughter Michal in marriage even though she was already married to David
